zh-cn.meta.title: MatchCore Arena | Minecraft 起床战争匹配与排名平台
zh-cn.meta.description: MatchCore Arena 为你匹配起床战争对局，记录每一场比赛，并用服务端加权 Elo 系统为你打分排名。注册账号、排队匹配、开局游玩。
zh-cn.banner.subtitle: 排队开局，玩起床战争，冲分上榜
zh-cn.banner.stat1.label: 评分引擎
zh-cn.banner.stat2.label: 对战模式
zh-cn.banner.stat3.label: 登录方式
zh-cn.features.title: 你能玩到什么
zh-cn.features.description: MatchCore Arena 围绕起床战争提供匹配、结算与排名：排队即开局，每场对局都会计入你的分数与战绩。
zh-cn.features.item1.title: 起床战争匹配
zh-cn.features.item1.desc: 单排或与好友组队，按分数窗口匹配 1v1 或 2v2 对局，成局后直接进入游戏服务器。
zh-cn.features.item2.title: 加权 Elo 评分
zh-cn.features.item2.desc: 每场结束的对局由服务端统一结算，生存、连胜与个人表现都会计入分数变化。
zh-cn.features.item3.title: 赛季排行榜
zh-cn.features.item3.desc: 按赛季查看 1v1 与 2v2 排行榜，随时查看自己的名次与分数。
zh-cn.features.item4.title: 完整战绩
zh-cn.features.item4.desc: 职业生涯页记录你的每一场比赛：参与者、击杀与死亡、分数变化一目了然。
zh-cn.highlights.title: 如何开始
zh-cn.highlights.item1.title: 1. 注册账号
zh-cn.highlights.item1.desc: 在 HRPAuth 账号门户（auth.mcnb.dev）注册，一个账号即可登录整个生态的服务。
zh-cn.highlights.item2.title: 2. 准备客户端
zh-cn.highlights.item2.desc: 从仓库获取 MatchCoreArena 桌面客户端。目前尚未发布现成的下载包，按文档指引在本地构建。
zh-cn.highlights.item3.title: 3. 排队匹配
zh-cn.highlights.item3.desc: 在客户端中单排或组队排队，匹配成功后客户端会把对局移交给你的 Minecraft 启动器。
zh-cn.highlights.item4.title: 4. 开局上分
zh-cn.highlights.item4.desc: 进入游戏服务器打一场起床战争，结果自动上报，评分与排行榜随之更新。
zh-cn.about.title: 关于 MatchCore Arena
zh-cn.about.p1: MatchCore Arena 是起床战争对局背后的匹配与评分服务：负责组成对局、结算结果、维护排行榜。它是 MatchCore 生态的一部分，全部代码开源。
zh-cn.about.p2: 账号由 HRPAuth 提供，文档在维基上，开发在 GitHub 公开进行。遇到问题时，议题跟踪器与维基 FAQ 是求助的入口。
zh-cn.resources.title: 文档、账号与源代码
zh-cn.resources.description: 这一页之外的内容都在维基、账号门户与代码仓库里。
zh-cn.resources.docs.title: 文档与 FAQ
zh-cn.resources.docs.desc: 在生态维基上查阅指南、配置参考与常见问题解答。
zh-cn.resources.demo.title: 账号门户
zh-cn.resources.demo.desc: 注册、登录，并管理你的账号安全设置与双因素验证。
zh-cn.resources.source.title: 源代码
zh-cn.resources.source.desc: 桌面客户端与竞技场服务均公开开发，问题与建议请提交到议题跟踪器。

en.meta.title: MatchCore Arena | Bedwars matchmaking and rankings for Minecraft
en.meta.description: MatchCore Arena matches you into Bedwars games, records every match, and ranks you with a server-side weighted Elo rating. Create an account, queue up, and play.
en.banner.subtitle: Queue up, play Bedwars, climb the ladder
en.banner.stat1.label: Ranking engine
en.banner.stat2.label: Match modes
en.banner.stat3.label: Sign-in
en.features.title: What You Can Play
en.features.description: MatchCore Arena covers matchmaking, settlement, and rankings for Bedwars: queue up, play, and every match counts toward your score and record.
en.features.item1.title: Bedwars Matchmaking
en.features.item1.desc: Queue solo or with friends for 1v1 or 2v2 matches formed by rating window, then join the game server when a match is found.
en.features.item2.title: Weighted Elo Ratings
en.features.item2.desc: Every finished match is settled on the server — survival, streaks, and individual performance all feed into your score changes.
en.features.item3.title: Season Rankings
en.features.item3.desc: Browse the 1v1 and 2v2 leaderboards by season and check your own rank and score at any time.
en.features.item4.title: Full Match History
en.features.item4.desc: Your career page lists every recorded match with participants, kills and deaths, and server-computed score deltas.
en.highlights.title: How It Works
en.highlights.item1.title: 1. Create your account
en.highlights.item1.desc: Register at the HRPAuth account portal (auth.mcnb.dev). One account signs you into the whole ecosystem.
en.highlights.item2.title: 2. Set up the client
en.highlights.item2.desc: Get the MatchCoreArena desktop client from the repository. Prebuilt downloads are not published yet, so follow the docs to build it locally.
en.highlights.item3.title: 3. Queue and match
en.highlights.item3.desc: Queue solo or as a party in the client. When a match forms, the client hands the game off to your Minecraft launcher.
en.highlights.item4.title: 4. Play and climb
en.highlights.item4.desc: Play the Bedwars match on the game server. Results are reported automatically, and your rating and rankings update.
en.about.title: About MatchCore Arena
en.about.p1: MatchCore Arena is the matchmaking and rating service behind Bedwars matches: it forms games, settles results, and keeps the ladder. It is open source and part of the wider MatchCore ecosystem.
en.about.p2: Accounts are handled by HRPAuth, documentation lives on the wiki, and development happens in the open on GitHub. When something goes wrong, the issue tracker and the wiki FAQ are the places to go.
en.resources.title: Docs, Account, and Source
en.resources.description: Everything beyond this page lives in the wiki, the account portal, and the repositories.
en.resources.docs.title: Docs & FAQ
en.resources.docs.desc: Guides, configuration references, and frequently asked questions on the ecosystem wiki.
en.resources.demo.title: Account Portal
en.resources.demo.desc: Register, sign in, and manage your account security and two-factor verification.
en.resources.source.title: Source Code
en.resources.source.desc: The desktop client and the arena service are developed in the open. Report issues on GitHub.
